stem.text: A probe is used to monitor the quality of the water in the sea. The probe is suspended by a vertical string which is attached to a sphere. The stationary sphere floats in equilibrium on the surface of the sea, as shown.

stem.alt: Sphere floating at the surface of the sea, suspended by a vertical string from a probe; labels sphere, air, sea, string and probe.

stem.text: The sphere has a weight of $5.00\,\text{N}$. The probe and string have a combined weight of $2.00\,\text{N}$.
The density of the seawater is $1.03 \times 10^{3}\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$. The upthrust acting on the probe and thread is negligible.
What is the volume of the sphere below the surface of the sea?
